audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer claimed Akali wins all seven rows, including 2+ items; the full layer said Kassadin at 2+ items. The two layers also disagreed at rows 0, 3 and 5 (full read Skill).
audit.why: Kassadin is the scaling half of this lane — Riftwalk drops to a 2s cooldown and Void Stone reduces the magic damage Akali's whole kit deals — so 'Akali favoured at 2+ items' is the row that is wrong, not the full layer's.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 Akali on both layers; row 6 Kassadin on both layers (win[6] flipped, phases[6].side already correct). whys[6] and phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] said Kassadin was 'hiding behind Riftwalk cooldowns' at levels 3-5.
audit.why: Riftwalk does not exist before level 6. The real level 3-5 spike is that his only answer is a 60-mana Null Sphere.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around the actual timings: level 3 full combo, level 6 Perfect Execution vs a 5s Riftwalk, first item before his mana items, and a late row that concedes the scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three kit errors: Null Sphere described as 'silence poke'; Riftwalk described as a 'fifteen-second' cooldown; and Null Sphere's magic shield and Void Stone were absent from the page entirely.
audit.why: Riot's text for Null Sphere is damage + interrupting channels + a shield that absorbs magic damage — no silence. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s; its cost, not its cooldown, is the limiter. Void Stone reduces magic damage taken and ignores unit collision, which matters more against Akali than against almost anyone: her entire combo is magic damage, and she cannot minion-block him.
audit.corrected: Bait Null Sphere out on its 9s before committing; expect Void Stone to blunt chip so trade for the all-in, not for HP; the Nether Blade auto-reset wind-up is his damage tell; and your own Q casts near him charge Force Pulse.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. The one number on the page (fifteen seconds for Riftwalk) was wrong.
audit.why: Without the real numbers the advice cannot say when to step up.
audit.corrected: Null Sphere 9s at rank 1 to 7s maxed, Force Pulse 21s and charged by your own casts, Riftwalk 5s at rank 1 — all written into breakdown.cooldowns and used as the sequencing trigger elsewhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Force Pulse's charging mechanic was never mentioned.
audit.why: 'Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity' — spamming Q at him charges his own cone for him, which is a genuine reason to space your poke.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[1].why, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Void Stone ignores unit collision, so the usual 'stand behind the minion wall' answer does not apply to his approach.

edits.before: Your advantage holds into the late game as long as he hasn't fully itemized his mana problems away — Shroud denies his blink-vision setup and your burst punishes him before Riftwalk resets let him disengage.
edits.after: Late the lane turns over: with mana items and a 2s Riftwalk he blinks out of your R, and Void Stone cuts your magic burst. Kill him on the step-up out of Shroud, or make him fight your team instead.
